name: Bold YouTube Thumbnail
background: Saturated gradient or sunburst with studio keylight; subject cut-out with white sticker outline and rim bloom
shapes: Large circles, arrows, burst shapes behind subject; 1-2 accent bars
textTreatment: 3-5 words max, 14-18% of canvas width per letter row height, thick stroke (text-shadow ring) + drop shadow, one keyword in accent colour
avoid: clutter, thin fonts, text under 10% of height, more than 3 colours
promptHint: Make the face/subject huge, emotion high, headline readable at 120px wide.

name: Glassmorphism
background: Blurred colourful mesh gradient blobs
shapes: Frosted translucent cards with 1px light border, rounded 3% radius
textTreatment: Clean medium-weight type on glass cards; one bold headline
avoid: backdrop-filter if export must be html2canvas (use opaque rgba fallback)
promptHint: Layer 2-3 glass panels over soft blobs; keep text inside panels.

name: Neumorphism
background: Single flat tinted background colour
shapes: Raised/pressed soft shapes using paired light/dark shadows
textTreatment: Low-contrast headings are not allowed: text must keep >=4.5:1 contrast
avoid: pure white on white text, hard shadows
promptHint: Subtle depth only; add one accent colour for focal element.

name: Neon Cyberpunk
background: Near-black gradient, perspective grid or city silhouette, scanlines
shapes: Neon outlines, diagonal light bars, glitch slices
textTreatment: Uppercase, wide tracking, neon glow on keyword, glitch offset in magenta/cyan
promptHint: Glow only on 1-2 elements so it stays readable.

name: Synthwave / 80s
background: Purple-to-pink sky gradient, striped retro sun, perspective grid floor
shapes: Palm silhouettes, chrome text
textTreatment: Chrome/gradient title with pink-cyan outline
promptHint: Horizon at 60% height; sun centred behind title.

name: Minimal Swiss
background: Solid background, one accent block
shapes: Grid lines, large type, generous whitespace (40%+ empty)
textTreatment: Left aligned, strict baseline grid, 2 sizes only (huge + small)
promptHint: One idea, huge type, lots of space.

name: Brutalist
background: Flat colour blocks, thick black borders
shapes: Hard offset shadows, overlapping rectangles, rotated labels
textTreatment: All caps, huge, tight leading, black on yellow/white
promptHint: Hard 8px offset shadows, 6px black borders.

name: Cinematic Poster
background: Teal-orange or obsidian-amber studio stage backdrop, volumetric keylight, letterbox bars, heavy vignette
shapes: Light rays, rim-bloom aura, floor contact shadows, title block at bottom third
textTreatment: Expressive display serif/cinzel title with balanced highlight word, small credits line
promptHint: Use rule of thirds; subject lit from one side.

name: Magazine Editorial
background: Warm editorial paper tone or emerald backdrop with full-bleed framed subject
shapes: Thin rules, masthead, cover lines, issue number
textTreatment: Mix of expressive serif title and crisp geometric sans captions
promptHint: Masthead on top; title overlaps the subject slightly.

name: Dark Luxury
background: Deep obsidian or velvet charcoal with volumetric studio spotlight and fine gold lines
shapes: Thin gold borders, ornamental corners, soft spotlight pedestal
textTreatment: Gold gradient text or luminous amber, wide letter spacing, small caps for details
promptHint: Less is more; centre-align; spotlight behind subject.

name: Pastel Soft
background: Soft gradient with blobs and sparkles
shapes: Rounded shapes, cloud blobs, hearts/stars
textTreatment: Rounded friendly font, dark plum text on pastel for contrast
promptHint: Keep text colour dark enough for 4.5:1.

name: Pop Art / Comic
background: Halftone dots, bold flat colours, speech bubbles
shapes: Starburst callouts, thick black outlines, speed lines
textTreatment: Bangers-style title, black outline 6px, offset shadow
promptHint: Use POW/WOW style bursts sparingly.

name: Grunge Street
background: Dark concrete texture, torn paper edges, tape strips
shapes: Spray marks, stencil text, scribbles
textTreatment: Marker/stencil type, rotated -3deg, white with black outline
promptHint: Imperfection is the point: slight rotations, uneven spacing.

name: Sticker Pop
background: Flat bright colour with confetti dots
shapes: Die-cut stickers with white outline and soft shadow
textTreatment: Chunky rounded text inside sticker label
promptHint: Each element looks like a peel-off sticker.

name: Gradient Mesh Modern
background: Multi-colour mesh gradient with grain
shapes: Minimal geometric accents, thin outlines
textTreatment: Large clean sans, white, one gradient word
promptHint: Gradient + grain removes the 'cheap' look.

name: Flat Vector Illustration
background: Solid colour background with simple shape scenery
shapes: Geometric characters/objects built from SVG circles, rects, paths
textTreatment: Friendly bold text with plenty of padding
promptHint: Limit to 4-5 flat colours + 1 shadow tone.

name: Paper Cut Layers
background: Stacked wavy layers each with soft drop shadow
shapes: Layered cut-out silhouettes (hills, clouds, lanterns)
textTreatment: Title on top layer with subtle emboss
promptHint: 3-5 layers, darker towards the back.

name: Isometric / 3D CSS
background: Soft gradient floor with isometric grid
shapes: CSS-transformed cubes/cards using rotateX(60deg) rotateZ(45deg)
textTreatment: Clean sans labels on floating cards
promptHint: Keep lighting consistent: light from top-left.

name: Holographic / Iridescent
background: Conic/linear iridescent gradients with noise
shapes: Chrome blobs, orbit rings, sparkles
textTreatment: Chrome or iridescent gradient text over dark/white
promptHint: Dark base makes iridescence pop.

name: Blueprint / Technical
background: Deep blue with fine white grid
shapes: Dimension lines, callout arrows, circles, corner brackets
textTreatment: Monospace-like uppercase labels, thin lines
promptHint: Everything aligned to the grid, 1-2px lines.

name: Watercolor Wash
background: Soft bleeding colour washes via blurred radial gradients on paper tone
shapes: Brush-stroke underline, splatter dots
textTreatment: Handwritten or serif, dark ink colour
promptHint: Overlap 3 blurred blobs with multiply blend.

name: Anime Glow
background: Gradient sky, bokeh circles, speed lines, petals
shapes: Sparkles, glow rims, diagonal action lines
textTreatment: Bold title with white outline and soft pink/blue glow
promptHint: Rim light on subject; never copy existing characters.

name: Doodle Hand-Drawn
background: Paper or notebook grid background
shapes: Hand-drawn arrows, stars, underlines, circles (SVG paths)
textTreatment: Handwritten font, slight random rotation
promptHint: Slightly imperfect strokes with round line caps.

name: Riso Retro Print
background: Off-white paper with 2-3 overprinting spot colours (multiply)
shapes: Misregistered shapes, halftone gradients
textTreatment: Overprint text using mix-blend-mode multiply
promptHint: Limit to 2-3 inks; overlaps create new colours.
